issues.claim: 2D physicochemical descriptors may add membrane-partitioning information not sufficiently explicit in current fingerprints/embeddings.
evidence: Broccatelli 2011 used pharmacophoric features and membrane-partition-related physicochemical properties; current project has accepted CheM/MiniMol/Morgan assets.
counterevidence: Current model outputs may already encode these properties; Pro005 found mixed floor outcomes and some near-identical candidate predictions.
issues.owner: partition_owner then designated score_owner; scientific interpretation by task owner
issues.reopen_trigger: Accepted Pgp train-only split manifest with row identity, fold membership and hash; descriptor implementation fixed and train-fit-only.
issues.stop: No stable descriptor increment or no improvement in full low-support/consensus-error groups; do not extend into parameter grid.

issues.claim: BBB prediction may be limited by ionization, polarity, passive permeability and efflux interactions.
evidence: Martins 2012 literature-derived set was enriched for BBB positives; common logBB threshold is -1.
counterevidence: No row-level pKa, pH, logD or transporter-substrate labels; Pro005 BBB floor outcomes mixed.
issues.owner: data lineage owner; score owner for train-only cohorts
issues.reopen_trigger: Three-representation same-head train-only comparison plus validated source fields or stable residual/consensus-error group.
issues.stop: No relation between low support and error; no descriptor increment; no source fields.

issues.claim: Multiple binding pharmacophores and physicochemical features may be underrepresented by simple 2D encodings.
evidence: Wang 2016 explicitly combines multiple pharmacophore hypotheses and ML.
counterevidence: TDC hERG is only 648 compounds; Pro005 floor direction inconsistent; no new task-level scores.
issues.reopen_trigger: Accepted train-only split and complete three-representation baseline; persistent full consensus-error group supports a spatial pharmacophore module.
issues.stop: No reproducible representation/readout gap; do not add seeds or floor sweeps.

issues.claim: Probe-dependent bioluminescent assay and isozyme/library differences may contribute to mixed results.
evidence: Veith 2009 recombinant CYP panel; PubChem AID1851 multi-concentration CYP-Glo protocol.
counterevidence: No row-level assay/source mapping; Pro005 only recorded small two-seed F010 support without native confirmation.
issues.owner: assay lineage owner and partition owner
issues.reopen_trigger: Verified original assay-source mapping for train rows and accepted train-only folds.
issues.stop: If within-source and between-source performance are indistinguishable, stop heterogeneity branch.

issues.claim: Productive binding/site-of-metabolism information and six-source heterogeneity may limit 2D classification.
evidence: TDC says six publications merged; Ahlström 2007 experimentally validates productive CYP2C9 poses/metabolites for a distinct compound series.
counterevidence: No mapping from Carbon-Mangels rows to those six source assays; prior weighted BCE/Morgan fixed matrix did not support replacement; Mini mixed.
issues.reopen_trigger: Six-source lineage plus accepted independent train-only split and stable representation-specific failure group.
issues.stop: Do not port CYP2D6 recipe or repeat weighted BCE/Morgan; no source mapping means no assay subgroup experiment.

issues.claim: Current published split register does not expose accepted task-specific train-only partitions for these five endpoints.
evidence: Pro005 split_register lists Hep HOOF folds and AMES/PPBR stress partitions only.
issues.reopen_trigger: Provide immutable split manifest, original row mapping, fold/fit/stop membership, seed, hash, and leakage/grouping policy for each task.
issues.stop: No training/score proposal is executable until exact partition is bound.

issues.claim: AP cannot be relabeled official AUPRC without source-level metric equivalence.
evidence: Project scoring policy requires official scorer/contract evidence and explicit naming.
issues.reopen_trigger: Official benchmark metric source and implementation mapping supplied.
issues.stop: Report AP as AP only; do not claim official AUPRC.
